paper.title_en: Holographic SU(3) color superconductivity from color-octet condensation in AdS$_4$
paper.abstract_en: We present a holographic model of $SU(3)$ color superconductivity in asymptotically AdS$_4$ in which scalar and vector color-octet condensates form at finite baryon chemical potential. At $μ_b=0$, a channel scan within consistent truncations shows that the favored sector reproduces the known $SU(2)$ s+p competition. At finite $μ_b$, the s-wave order generalizes to an $S_1+iS_2$ structure. In the probe limit, the $S_+$ critical temperature grows linearly with $μ_b/μ_3$, while the p-wave critical temperature is independent of $μ_b$. Once backreaction is included, the p-wave critical temperature decreases with $μ_b$ and the p-wave phase disappears beyond a critical value of $μ_b$. At high $μ_b$, the balanced $S_+$ phase (with $S_1=S_2$) is the dominant color-superconducting phase, while the $S_-$ condensate, which signals the imbalance between $S_1$ and $S_2$, appears only at low temperature and low baryon density. Our results provide a holographic laboratory for color-octet condensation and non-Abelian color dynamics in dense matter such as neutron-star interiors.
